traits.safety: Guarantee the invocation reaches exactly the named provider and the envelope error contract holds (in-process > authenticated remote > best-effort).
traits.zero_config: Works with no operator opt-in or extra configuration.
traits.remote_capable: Can reach providers outside this runtime node. Registration requires verified endpoint auth + tenant-scope handling; credentials never serialize (secrets travel by reference through secret-resolver); timeoutMs must be enforced — unbounded remote calls are a governance violation.

evidence: libs/core/provider/loopback-transport.ts (resolves the provider on coreSeamCatalog and invokes in-process; preserves local_first)

invoke.description: Execute one capability operation on the named seam/provider and return the envelope result.

remote_execute.description: Execute on a provider hosted outside this runtime node (worker pool / RPC peer).
